answer: Burn 1,000 PRF per identity: the payer sends to an unspendable reef address on the beacon chain, with the burn transaction’s Merkle receipt as evidence. This is irreversible loss, not capital lockup; the fable of refundable stake is false. Total cost is 1,000N PRF, and any identity reset requires a fresh burn, so N fakes plus N resets cost 2,000N PRF.
